news.title: Pirro's losses in Fed investigation should stay on the books, judge rules
news.detail: In a scathing ruling, Judge James Boasberg denied U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro's request to vacate his earlier orders.

insight.what: 法官裁决保留Pirro在美联储调查中的损失记录
insight.assets:
📉 美联储公信力 承压
📉 美元 短期偏弱
insight.chain: 司法审查削弱美联储独立性（央行决策受干扰），市场可能定价政策不确定性，避险资产（黄金）受支撑

news.title: SpaceX’s Gwynne Shotwell had IPO doubts for years, now she has a message for investors
news.detail: Gwynne Shotwell, long Elon Musk's second-in-command at SpaceX, spoke exclusively with CNBC ahead of her company's highly anticipated IPO.

insight.what: Gwynne Shotwell曾多年质疑IPO，现向投资者传递信心
insight.assets:
📈 SpaceX 估值支撑
📈 科技成长股 情绪改善
insight.chain: 高管态度转变缓解估值担忧，但前期犹豫暗示内部风险（如技术或盈利压力），需关注后续财报（财务报告）

news.title: Small investors scrambled to get in on the SpaceX IPO, even as some believe the valuation is 'stupid'
news.detail: While SpaceX's IPO has caused alarm that it may be overvalued, some retail investors still want in.

insight.assets:

news.title: For Warsh as Fed chair, silence may be the point
news.detail: Kevin Warsh will hold his first Fed meeting, giving markets the first public look at how he'll communicate as chair of the Federal Reserve.

insight.what: Warsh任美联储主席可能保持沉默策略

📈 美元 短期稳定
📉 美债收益率 波动性降低
insight.chain: 沉默减少政策信号（前瞻指引缺失），市场将更依赖数据，短期利率预期（联邦基金利率期货）或更僵化
